Biology Subject Matter Expert - AI Content Specialist

$35-55/hrRemoteFreelanceSTEM

About the Role

We're looking for biology experts to help evaluate and improve AI systems being trained on advanced scientific content. Your knowledge will directly shape how AI understands and reasons through complex biology — from cellular mechanisms to graduate-level concepts that push the boundaries of what AI can do.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. You set your hours, work independently, and contribute to some of the most exciting AI research happening today.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Design challenging, advanced biology questions to rigorously test AI performance
  • Develop clear, step-by-step solutions with well-structured scientific reasoning
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, depth, and quality of logic
  • Identify gaps, errors, and weaknesses in AI outputs across biological domains
  • Collaborate with researchers to refine benchmarks spanning undergraduate to Masters-level biology topics
  • Work independently and asynchronously on your own schedule

Who You Are

  • Pursuing or holding a Master's degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a closely related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills across advanced biology topics
  • Able to communicate complex scientific ideas clearly and precisely in writing
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to scientific accuracy
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently
  • No prior AI experience required

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data annotation, data quality assessment, or evaluation frameworks
  • Familiarity with AI or machine learning concepts
  • Background spanning multiple biology sub-disciplines (e.g., molecular biology, genetics, physiology, ecology)

Why Join Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside world-leading research labs
  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule from anywhere
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and the ability to contribute at your own pace
  • Gain firsthand exposure to how large language models are developed and evaluated
  • Contribute to meaningful work that advances the scientific accuracy of AI systems
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension
